findings.note: Judge first (7ac94c2): a new 'recording a take' state, and the landscape photo check counts uncovered px down the photo's middle; it found 0 px at 844x390 and 667x375. Fix (570b894): under 600 px tall in landscape (below 1024 px) a take lays the room out as one screen, photo left, Voice card docked right; strip, rail, transport and the Stage's words step aside.

7ac94c2: chrome is excused only while scrolling can uncover the control. The direction is the reverse of the finding's text: content under TOP chrome is uncovered by scrolling up, so it needs scrollY > 0; under BOTTOM chrome it needs room to scroll down. The Filmstrip's sticky handle is excused only while its strip scrolls sideways.
